anonymous read of help.sap.com's own published content service (http.svc/pagecontent). No login, no api.sap.com traffic, no DOM scraping.

complete for this source: every row of the published table was parsed, and 1149 distinct scope-item/scenario pairs resulted. Floor with respect to SAP overall — a scope item whose scenario SAP documents only in its Set-Up Instructions (SAP Signavio Process Navigator, login required) and not in this table is not here, and the size of that gap cannot be measured from this source.
353 distinct scope items appear in the table
PUBLISHED on every row: SAP states the scope item and the communication scenario in the same table row. No row in this file is derived.

mandatory is empty on every row: the published table does not state whether a scenario is mandatory or optional for the scope item. SAP states that per scope item in its Set-Up Instructions. Empty means not published, not "optional".

17 source rows carry no scope item because SAP marks them "Relevant for solution" (the interface applies to the whole solution, not one scope item). They are kept with an empty scope_item_id and the evidence says so, rather than dropped.
this file states what SAP publishes for release 2608. It says nothing about what any tenant has activated or arranged.
